The doors close at 8:00 a.m.

Test centers open at 7:45 and doors close at 8:00. Testing starts around 8:15 to 8:30, but that's not extra time to arrive. Plan backward from 7:45.

Good luck today. Follow @samsonsatprep for more SAT tips.
